input.title: Tapping between a single-line thought and a multiline thought causes layout shift
input.body:
Tested on iOS Safari

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- A wrinkle in time
- This is a multiline thought with no formatting
```

1. Set the caret on `A`
2. Set the caret on `This is a multiline thought with no formatting`

## Expected behavior

No layout shift.

## Current behavior

There is a perceptible layout shift.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/11b1fc63-5df1-4276-90c2-4ac5498c849f

---

I'm guessing that this would be related to `preventAutoscroll`, but it's notable that it can be reproduced with only 2 thoughts.
